subject: Nimble Retail - pen test follow-up: evidence & scope questions
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Glover <alex.glover@nimble.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nimble Retail - pen test follow-up: evidence & scope questions

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for sharing the pen test report last week. We reviewed the findings flagged as high/critical and want to confirm the remediation status so we can close the related control evidence for our SOC 2 scope. To help us validate the fixes we need the following artifacts per finding: 

- Screenshots (or screen recordings) showing the vulnerable endpoint in the staging environment before/after the change.
- Config snippets / policy text (e.g., WAF rule IDs, firewall ACL entries, nginx conf lines) with line numbers redacted where appropriate.
- Ticket references (JIRA IDs) with the remediation PRs linked and short notes summarizing root cause + mitigation.
- If a full patch is not applied, please describe compensating controls (WAF, IP allowlist, increased logging/alerting) and provide evidence (logs, alert rule ids).

For priority: please prioritize the two items marked ‘critical’ in the report (Auth bypass on /api/v1/session and exposed debug endpoints). If you can upload a single zip with screenshots + config snippets and a CSV of ticket IDs that would be ideal.

Can you confirm ETA for these artifacts? We have a compliance checkpoint with internal audit the week of Nov 17, so if possible we’d like the evidence by Nov 13.

Thanks — feel free to call if easier to walk through.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

From: Alex Glover <alex.glover@nimble.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@nimble.com, Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimble.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimble Retail - pen test follow-up: evidence & scope questions

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the clear list. We’ve started collecting artifacts and I wanted to confirm a few scope points so we send precisely what you need: 

1) The auth bypass was fixed in our staging cluster with a two-part change (auth middleware update + token validation added in the gateway). Are you ok with screenshots from staging (staging-1.nimble.internal) or do you need evidence from a pre-production mirror we maintain?

2) For the exposed debug endpoints, we removed the endpoints and added an allowlist in front of the admin paths. We can provide WAF rule snippets (aws wafv2) and a screenshot of the rule in the console.

We will prepare: nimble_fix_screenshots.zip (screenshots + short screencast), waf_rules_snippet.txt (redacted), and a CSV with ticket IDs and PR links. I’m aiming to upload to the Drive folder by EOD Monday (Nov 10).

Quick note: a couple of lower-severity items were mitigated with compensating controls (rate limit + enhanced logging). I’ll include a short write-up for those.

Does that timeline work?

—Alex
Head of Security Operations
Nimble Retail Inc.

Attachments: (none in this reply — artifacts to follow via Drive link)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Nimble Retail - pen test follow-up: evidence & scope questions

Mina / Marissa —

Looping in a couple of quick technical checks I want in the artifact set before we accept closure: 

- For the auth bypass: we need a snippet of the middleware change (3–5 lines showing the added token validation logic) and a sample request/response header capture from staging demonstrating 401 -> 200 before fix and 401 -> 401 after (or vice versa depending on repro). If they can’t share exact code, a redacted diff with filenames is OK.

- For the WAF: provide the exact rule ID and the matching condition (path regex) and a short note confirming whether WAF is regional or global (for multi-region routing).

- For compensating controls: example alerting rule from their monitoring (pagerduty escalation id or alert name) and an example log line showing detection of the attempted exploit and the alert firing.

Also confirm that they’ve updated their deployment pipeline to prevent regressions (we’d like the PR link that adds the test case or CI gate if available). If they’ll only provide screenshots, we should ask for time-bounded video or replay showing the test scenario.

If you want, I can draft a checklist we use internally for evidence acceptance.

-David
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Glover <alex.glover@nimble.com>, security@nimble.com
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimble Retail - pen test follow-up: evidence & scope questions

Alex / Nimble security team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround commitment. To be explicit about what we’ll accept for each of the two critical findings: 

A) Auth bypass (/api/v1/session) — acceptable artifacts:
  - Redacted diff or code snippet showing the auth validation change (3–10 lines)
  - Staging request/response capture (curl or HTTPie output) showing prior behaviour and current behaviour, with timestamps
  - JIRA ticket(s) that reference both the bug and the remediation PR

B) Exposed debug endpoints — acceptable artifacts:
  - Screenshot of the WAF rule in the AWS console + waf_rules_snippet.txt with rule ID and path regex
  - Confirmation whether the rule is regional or global + affected regions
  - If the endpoint was removed, a short server log snippet showing 404 or 403 responses post-removal.

C) Compensating controls (for lower-severity items):
  - Alert rule name in your monitoring (e.g., "NR-Exploit-Attempt-Detection") and an example alert payload
  - Ticket IDs for any mitigations (rate limit, improved logging)

Please upload a single zip and a JIRA export CSV to the Drive link David included earlier, and paste the Drive URL in the reply. As a reminder we’re targeting Nov 13 for internal audit evidence ingestion, so EOD Nov 10 is our preferred upload window to allow a short QA pass.

If any of this is blocked by NDAs or customer data restrictions, state what you can share and provide a call time so we can agree on a redaction strategy.

Thanks —
Mina
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimble_evidence_template.xlsx (template for screenshots/config mapping)

From: Alex Glover <alex.glover@nimble.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimble.com>, security@nimble.com
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimble Retail - pen test follow-up: evidence & scope questions

Mina —

We uploaded the initial bundle to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nimble-pen-test-evidence (shared with your team). Contents: 

- nimble_fix_screenshots.zip (screenshots + two short screencasts showing before/after for auth and WAF)
- waf_rules_snippet.txt (redacted, includes rule IDs: rule-aws-8921, rule-aws-8922)
- JIRA-TICKETS-EXPORT.csv (NR-1254, NR-1267, NR-1279)
- JIRA-NOTES.txt (one-line summary per ticket + PR links)

Per David’s asks: 
- We included a redacted diff for the middleware (middleware_patch_redacted.diff) showing the token validation change.
- Staging request/response captures are in captures/auth_repro_before.txt and captures/auth_repro_after.txt.
- WAF is configured regionally (us-west-2); waf_rules_snippet.txt includes the path regex and the rule IDs.
- Compensating controls: NR-1279 references rate limiting changes; alert rule name is "NR-Exploit-Attempt-Detection" and we included an example alert payload in monitoring/alert_example.json (redacted PII).

If you need live access to staging for replay, we can schedule a 30-minute session this week. Otherwise, let me know if anything is missing in the bundle.

—Alex
Head of Security Operations
Nimble Retail Inc.

Attachments: nimble_fix_screenshots.zip; waf_rules_snippet.txt; JIRA-TICKETS-EXPORT.csv
